title: How to Fix Renewable Energy’s Hidden Infrastructure Problem | WSJ Pro Perfected
speaker: The Wall Street Journal
zh: 【The Wall Street Journal】如何解決再生能源的隱藏基礎設施問題| 《華爾街日報》專業版已完善（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Renewable energy, like wind and solar has created a hidden infrastructure problem.
cues.en: Renewable energy, like wind and solar has created a hidden infrastructure problem.
cues.zh: 風能和太陽能等再生能源造成了隱藏的基礎設施問題。

cues.text: The issue is that power grids, which carry electricity to homes and businesses weren't designed for wind and solar.
cues.en: The issue is that power grids, which carry electricity to homes and businesses weren't designed for wind and solar.
cues.zh: 問題在於，為家庭和企業輸送電力的電網並不是為風能和太陽能而設計的。

cues.text: And even though renewables have become a larger part of the overall power supply,
cues.en: And even though renewables have become a larger part of the overall power supply,
cues.zh: 儘管再生能源已成為整個電力供應的重要組成部分，

cues.text: grid infrastructure hasn't kept up.
cues.en: grid infrastructure hasn't kept up.
cues.zh: 電網基礎設施沒有跟上。

cues.text: It's why some grid experts say renewables contributed to the severity of the blackout across Spain
cues.en: It's why some grid experts say renewables contributed to the severity of the blackout across Spain
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼一些電網專家表示再生能源導致了西班牙全境停電的嚴重性

cues.text: and Portugal in April.
cues.en: and Portugal in April.
cues.zh: 四月和葡萄牙。

cues.text: So we asked a mechanical engineer with over 15 years of experience
cues.en: So we asked a mechanical engineer with over 15 years of experience
cues.zh: 所以我們請教了一位擁有超過15年經驗的機械工程師

cues.text: to explain the hidden risks of renewables and three ways to make the grid more resilient to disruptions.
cues.en: to explain the hidden risks of renewables and three ways to make the grid more resilient to disruptions.
cues.zh: 解釋再生能源的隱藏風險以及使電網更能抵禦幹擾的三種方法。

cues.text: Renewable power, wind and solar specifically, don't provide something we call
cues.en: Renewable power, wind and solar specifically, don't provide something we call
cues.zh: 再生能源，特別是風能和太陽能，不提供我們所說的東西

cues.text: inherent rotational inertia, which is something that has provided stability to the grid
cues.en: inherent rotational inertia, which is something that has provided stability to the grid
cues.zh: 固有的旋轉慣性，為電網提供了穩定性

cues.text: for decades since basically it was first invented.
cues.en: for decades since basically it was first invented.
cues.zh: 自從它被首次發明以來已經有幾十年了。

cues.text: Conventional power plants like coal and natural gas have inertia built into their design.
cues.en: Conventional power plants like coal and natural gas have inertia built into their design.
cues.zh: 煤炭和天然氣等傳統發電廠的設計中存在慣性。

cues.text: This is a 3D printed model of a gas turbine.
cues.en: This is a 3D printed model of a gas turbine.
cues.zh: 這是燃氣渦輪機的 3D 列印模型。

cues.text: So we burn the natural gas here and it creates this large spinning piece
cues.en: So we burn the natural gas here and it creates this large spinning piece
cues.zh: 所以我們在這裡燃燒天然氣，它創造了這個巨大的旋轉部件

cues.text: of rotating machinery.
cues.en: of rotating machinery.
cues.zh: 的旋轉機械。

cues.text: And this thing, this whole deal is connected to a generator that might be sitting over here
cues.en: And this thing, this whole deal is connected to a generator that might be sitting over here
cues.zh: 這件事，整個交易都與可能坐在這裡的發電機有關

cues.text: that produces our electricity.
cues.en: that produces our electricity.
cues.zh: 產生我們的電力。

cues.text: All conventional power plants produce electricity that matches the frequency on the grid,
cues.en: All conventional power plants produce electricity that matches the frequency on the grid,
cues.zh: 所有傳統發電廠產生的電力都與電網頻率相匹配，

cues.text: which is 60 hertz in the US.
cues.en: which is 60 hertz in the US.
cues.zh: 在美國是 60 赫茲。

cues.text: And all the power generators, they all need to be in sync.
cues.en: And all the power generators, they all need to be in sync.
cues.zh: 所有的發電機都需要同步。

cues.text: If a power plant goes down, the inertia provides buffer time for other energy sources to jump in.
cues.en: If a power plant goes down, the inertia provides buffer time for other energy sources to jump in.
cues.zh: 如果發電廠發生故障，慣性就會為其他能源的介入提供緩衝時間。

cues.text: Imagine how if you're riding a bike and you stop pedaling, you continue to move forward.
cues.en: Imagine how if you're riding a bike and you stop pedaling, you continue to move forward.
cues.zh: 想像一下，如果您正在騎腳踏車並且停止踩踏板，您將如何繼續前進。

cues.text: That's inertia.
cues.en: That's inertia.
cues.zh: 這就是慣性。

cues.text: The momentum that you have would help you get up the initial portion of that hill.
cues.en: The momentum that you have would help you get up the initial portion of that hill.
cues.zh: 你所擁有的動力將幫助你爬上那座山的最初部分。

cues.text: The grid can only tolerate a small change in frequency.
cues.en: The grid can only tolerate a small change in frequency.
cues.zh: 電網只能容忍頻率的微小變化。

cues.text: Anything too drastic and power plants will disconnect from the grid to protect themselves from damage.
cues.en: Anything too drastic and power plants will disconnect from the grid to protect themselves from damage.
cues.zh: 任何過於激烈的事情，發電廠都會與電網斷開連線，以保護自己免受損害。

cues.text: Using more renewable energy and fewer conventional power sources
cues.en: Using more renewable energy and fewer conventional power sources
cues.zh: 使用更多的可再生能源和更少的傳統能源

cues.text: means there's less inherent inertia in the network, which can increase the risk
cues.en: means there's less inherent inertia in the network, which can increase the risk
cues.zh: 意味著網路中固有的慣性較小，這會增加風險

cues.text: of widespread blackouts.
cues.en: of widespread blackouts.
cues.zh: 大面積停電。

cues.text: Solar by its nature is not actually rotating.
cues.en: Solar by its nature is not actually rotating.
cues.zh: 太陽本質上並不旋轉。

cues.text: And wind turbines, even though they are spinning, don't rotate at speeds that match the frequency of the grid.
cues.en: And wind turbines, even though they are spinning, don't rotate at speeds that match the frequency of the grid.
cues.zh: 風力渦輪機即使在旋轉，也不會以與電網頻率相符的速度旋轉。

cues.text: So one of the best solutions to address the lack of inherent rotational inertia is
cues.en: So one of the best solutions to address the lack of inherent rotational inertia is
cues.zh: 因此，解決固有轉動慣量缺乏的最佳解決方案之一是

cues.text: to use a grid-forming inverter.
cues.en: to use a grid-forming inverter.
cues.zh: 使用併網逆變器。

cues.text: This technology essentially provides renewable energy with synthetic inertia.
cues.en: This technology essentially provides renewable energy with synthetic inertia.
cues.zh: 該技術本質上是提供具有合成慣性的可再生能源。

cues.text: Most inverters at renewable power plants today are grid-following,
cues.en: Most inverters at renewable power plants today are grid-following,
cues.zh: 當今再生能源發電廠的逆變器大多是跟隨電網的，

cues.text: meaning they rely on the grid's voltage and frequency.
cues.en: meaning they rely on the grid's voltage and frequency.
cues.zh: 這意味著它們依賴電網的電壓和頻率。

cues.text: So if there's an outage, the inverter loses its reference and can't function.
cues.en: So if there's an outage, the inverter loses its reference and can't function.
cues.zh: 因此，如果發生斷電，逆變器就會失去參考並且無法運作。

cues.text: Grid-forming inverters are more advanced.
cues.en: Grid-forming inverters are more advanced.
cues.zh: 併網逆變器更加先進。

cues.text: They can operate independently and support the grid when there's a disruption.
cues.en: They can operate independently and support the grid when there's a disruption.
cues.zh: 它們可以獨立運作並在發生中斷時為電網提供支援。

cues.text: Here's how they work.
cues.en: Here's how they work.
cues.zh: 以下是它們的工作原理。

cues.text: The solar panel produces direct current.
cues.en: The solar panel produces direct current.
cues.zh: 太陽能板產生直流電。

cues.text: You could imagine it as sort of a constant supply of current coming out of the solar panel,
cues.en: You could imagine it as sort of a constant supply of current coming out of the solar panel,
cues.zh: 你可以把它想像成從太陽能板發出的恆定電流，

cues.text: but our grid operates on alternating current, and so we need to take this blue line
cues.en: but our grid operates on alternating current, and so we need to take this blue line
cues.zh: 但我們的電網使用交流電，所以我們需要走這條藍線

cues.text: and we need to turn it into a waveform that's operating at 60 hertz.
cues.en: and we need to turn it into a waveform that's operating at 60 hertz.
cues.zh: 我們需要將其轉換為工作頻率為 60 赫茲的波形。

cues.text: That's what a grid-forming inverter does.
cues.en: That's what a grid-forming inverter does.
cues.zh: 這就是併網逆變器的作用。

cues.text: And because it's adjusting everything electronically, it can react to frequency changes much faster
cues.en: And because it's adjusting everything electronically, it can react to frequency changes much faster
cues.zh: 而且由於它以電子方式調整一切，因此可以更快地對頻率變化做出反應

cues.text: than a conventional generator.
cues.en: than a conventional generator.
cues.zh: 比傳統發電機。

cues.text: It also has an endless supply of synthetic inertia.
cues.en: It also has an endless supply of synthetic inertia.
cues.zh: 它還具有源源不絕的合成慣性。

cues.text: Grid-forming inverters are really, really great at allowing us to, say, build a microgrid.
cues.en: Grid-forming inverters are really, really great at allowing us to, say, build a microgrid.
cues.zh: 電網形成逆變器真的非常非常適合讓我們建造微電網。

cues.text: So imagine a military installation, for instance.
cues.en: So imagine a military installation, for instance.
cues.zh: 例如，想像一下軍事設施。

cues.text: But Todd says they're not as effective when it comes to managing a larger region.
cues.en: But Todd says they're not as effective when it comes to managing a larger region.
cues.zh: 但託德表示，在管理更大的地區時，它們的效率並不高。

cues.text: You could imagine you've got all these different regions of some state that are all connected.
cues.en: You could imagine you've got all these different regions of some state that are all connected.
cues.zh: 您可以想像某個州的所有這些不同區域都是相互連線的。

cues.text: They all now need to be synchronized.
cues.en: They all now need to be synchronized.
cues.zh: 它們現在都需要同步。

cues.text: With rotational inertia, we have decades and decades of understanding
cues.en: With rotational inertia, we have decades and decades of understanding
cues.zh: 對於轉動慣量，我們有數十年的瞭解

cues.text: and history of managing across large regions.
cues.en: and history of managing across large regions.
cues.zh: 以及跨大區域管理的歷史。

cues.text: With an increasing penetration of renewables, we find ourselves in a new world
cues.en: With an increasing penetration of renewables, we find ourselves in a new world
cues.zh: 隨著再生能源的普及，我們發現自己處於一個新世界

cues.text: where we have new challenges to address.
cues.en: where we have new challenges to address.
cues.zh: 我們有新的挑戰需要解決。

cues.text: Grid-forming inverters also require additional measurements like voltage,
cues.en: Grid-forming inverters also require additional measurements like voltage,
cues.zh: 併網逆變器還需要額外的測量，例如電壓、

cues.text: frequency, and temperature, And that can be done by imagining, say, like we put in a whole bunch of instrumentation
cues.en: frequency, and temperature, And that can be done by imagining, say, like we put in a whole bunch of instrumentation
cues.zh: 頻率和溫度，這可以透過想像來完成，比如說，就像我們放入一大堆儀器一樣

cues.text: all over the grid to make sure that we've got awareness on what's happening
cues.en: all over the grid to make sure that we've got awareness on what's happening
cues.zh: 整個網格，以確保我們瞭解正在發生的事情

cues.text: at each location or within these transmission line on the grid.
cues.en: at each location or within these transmission line on the grid.
cues.zh: 在電網上的每個位置或這些輸電線路內。

cues.text: Todd's second solution to renewable energy's lack of inherent inertia
cues.en: Todd's second solution to renewable energy's lack of inherent inertia
cues.zh: 託德針對再生能源缺乏固有慣性的第二個解決方案

cues.text: is something called a synchronous condenser.
cues.en: is something called a synchronous condenser.
cues.zh: 是一種稱為同步冷凝器的東西。

cues.text: I am a mechanical engineer, and so I'm a bit of sucker for rotational machines.
cues.en: I am a mechanical engineer, and so I'm a bit of sucker for rotational machines.
cues.zh: 我是機械工程師，所以我對旋轉機器有點著迷。

cues.text: And a synchronous condenser is just that, a large spinning piece of machinery
cues.en: And a synchronous condenser is just that, a large spinning piece of machinery
cues.zh: 同步凝汽器就是一個大型旋轉機械

cues.text: similar to the gas turbine model you saw earlier.
cues.en: similar to the gas turbine model you saw earlier.
cues.zh: 類似於您之前看到的燃氣渦輪機模型。

cues.text: Instead of actually injecting natural gas into this system,
cues.en: Instead of actually injecting natural gas into this system,
cues.zh: 而非實際將天然氣注入該系統，

cues.text: we actually take electricity from the solar panel and we get this large spinning mass
cues.en: we actually take electricity from the solar panel and we get this large spinning mass
cues.zh: 我們實際上從太陽能電池板獲取電力，我們得到了這個巨大的旋轉質量

cues.text: that provides additional rotational inertia.
cues.en: that provides additional rotational inertia.
cues.zh: 這提供了額外的轉動慣量。

cues.text: He says, ideally this should be paired with a grid-forming inverter to get the best of both worlds.
cues.en: He says, ideally this should be paired with a grid-forming inverter to get the best of both worlds.
cues.zh: 他說，理想情況下，它應該與併網逆變器搭配使用，以獲得兩全其美的效果。

cues.text: There is a trade off that we have to acknowledge: not all that electricity is being sold into the marketplace.
cues.en: There is a trade off that we have to acknowledge: not all that electricity is being sold into the marketplace.
cues.zh: 我們必須承認一個權衡：並非所有電力都出售到市場上。

cues.text: Instead, some of that electricity needs to go into spinning this large piece of steel.
cues.en: Instead, some of that electricity needs to go into spinning this large piece of steel.
cues.zh: 相反，其中一些電力需要用於旋轉這塊大鋼鐵。

cues.text: It's essentially like buying insurance.
cues.en: It's essentially like buying insurance.
cues.zh: 這本質上就像是購買保險。

cues.text: It's a cost that is incurred, but it provides some level of risk adjustment benefit
cues.en: It's a cost that is incurred, but it provides some level of risk adjustment benefit
cues.zh: 這是產生的成本，但它提供了一定程度的風險調整效益

cues.text: to the overall grid so that it ensures that it continues to operate reliably.
cues.en: to the overall grid so that it ensures that it continues to operate reliably.
cues.zh: 到整個電網，以確保其繼續可靠運作。

cues.text: So our third opportunity to improve the resilience of the grid would be to have backup power supply,
cues.en: So our third opportunity to improve the resilience of the grid would be to have backup power supply,
cues.zh: 因此，我們提高電網彈性的第三個機會是擁有備用電源，

cues.text: what we call Battery Energy Storage Systems, or BESS.
cues.en: what we call Battery Energy Storage Systems, or BESS.
cues.zh: 我們稱之為電池儲能係統，或 BESS。

cues.text: So there's a transmission tower that's out here in the distance, and we provide power along these transmission lines
cues.en: So there's a transmission tower that's out here in the distance, and we provide power along these transmission lines
cues.zh: 遠處有一座輸電塔，我們沿著這些輸電線路提供電力

cues.text: and then eventually gets dropped down to this battery energy storage system.
cues.en: and then eventually gets dropped down to this battery energy storage system.
cues.zh: 然後最終下降到這個電池能量儲存系統。

cues.text: It stores power in one location, and it has large set of inverters in another location.
cues.en: It stores power in one location, and it has large set of inverters in another location.
cues.zh: 它在一個位置儲存電力，並在另一個位置擁有大量逆變器。

cues.text: And so the battery, this fills up with energy over time,
cues.en: And so the battery, this fills up with energy over time,
cues.zh: 所以電池隨著時間的推移會充滿能量，

cues.text: and then it gets provided to these inverters, and then those inverters eventually will feed back power
cues.en: and then it gets provided to these inverters, and then those inverters eventually will feed back power
cues.zh: 然後它被提供給這些逆變器，然後這些逆變器最終會回饋電力

cues.text: into the grid when it is needed.
cues.en: into the grid when it is needed.
cues.zh: 需要時將其插入網格。

cues.text: If there's an unexpected outage, batteries can deploy excess energy to stabilize the grid.
cues.en: If there's an unexpected outage, batteries can deploy excess energy to stabilize the grid.
cues.zh: 如果發生意外停電，電池可以釋放多餘的能量來穩定電網。

cues.text: The use of battery energy storage systems has been increasing at a significant rate
cues.en: The use of battery energy storage systems has been increasing at a significant rate
cues.zh: 電池儲能係統的使用正在以顯著的速度成長

cues.text: over the last handful of years, but prior to that, the cost of batteries were very high.
cues.en: over the last handful of years, but prior to that, the cost of batteries were very high.
cues.zh: 過去幾年，但在此之前，電池的成本非常高。

cues.text: Now the cost of batteries have declined so dramatically
cues.en: Now the cost of batteries have declined so dramatically
cues.zh: 現在電池的成本已經大幅下降

cues.text: that this is a solution set that is being brought to bear in significant quantities all across the world.
cues.en: that this is a solution set that is being brought to bear in significant quantities all across the world.
cues.zh: 這是一套正在全世界大量應用的解決方案。

cues.text: As renewable energy becomes more prevalent, Todd says the key to reducing the risk of widespread outages
cues.en: As renewable energy becomes more prevalent, Todd says the key to reducing the risk of widespread outages
cues.zh: 託德表示，隨著再生能源變得越來越普遍，降低大範圍停電風險的關鍵是

cues.text: is to keep building and improving the infrastructure supporting it.
cues.en: is to keep building and improving the infrastructure supporting it.
cues.zh: 一是不斷建設和完善支撐的基礎設施。

cues.text: All energy sources have trade-offs.
cues.en: All energy sources have trade-offs.
cues.zh: 所有能源都需要權衡。

cues.text: There is no silver bullet.
cues.en: There is no silver bullet.
cues.zh: 沒有靈丹妙藥。

cues.text: It's critical for us to keep thinking about how do we design in a way that we best balance
cues.en: It's critical for us to keep thinking about how do we design in a way that we best balance
cues.zh: 對我們來說，不斷思考如何以最佳平衡的方式進行設計至關重要

cues.text: all of these trade-offs.
cues.en: all of these trade-offs.
cues.zh: 所有這些權衡。
